I am a Myanmar-born American journalist living in the U.S. Last December, while traveling in Phuket with my family, my daughter became seriously ill with a severe flu. We urgently searched for the best medical care nearby and were fortunate to find Doctor Patong Clinic.

Our experience with Dr. Mon was nothing short of a miracle. She provided excellent care for our daughter at a very fair price, far exceeding our expectations. When my wife fell ill a day later—just as we were flying from Phuket to Bangkok—Dr. Mon showed the same compassion and attentiveness to her as well.

Dr. Mon is incredibly kind, attentive, and deeply caring. In my 50+ years, I have rarely encountered a doctor with such genuine humanity. We truly wish she could be our family doctor forever. We are profoundly grateful and will always remember her with appreciation.

I experienced severe food poisoning while staying in Karon Bay, and it began suddenly in the middle of the night. As my symptoms worsened, I became extremely dizzy and lethargic from not being able to stay hydrated. We contacted Doctor Patong Clinic, they immediately sent Dr. Mon to our hotel, she arrived with her assistant within 20 minutes.

Dr. Mon took care of me for two hours, checking my vital signs, administering treatment, and making sure I was stable and comfortable. Without the care, I genuinely wouldn’t have been able to travel the next day and continue the rest of our vacation. The IV treatment was an absolute lifesaver.

I would highly recommend this service if you find yourself in a similar situation. Don’t even think twice, if you’re suffering from food sickness, this service will save your holiday 🙏🏼💖

Me and my wife visited Dr. Mon for two different issues — my wife had a foot cut that needed proper care, and I was dealing with mild fever and a persistent, bothersome cough. For both of us, Dr. Mon was incredibly helpful, patient, and reassuring.

She clearly explained our treatment plans — how long to take each medicine, when to stop, and what signs to watch for. What stood out the most was that she never rushed us — she answered every small question with calmness and clarity, and her support gave both of us a lot of confidence and peace of mind.

Her follow-up the next day was a thoughtful gesture that truly reflected her commitment to her patients. Thanks to her guidance, my wife’s wound healed well, and I started feeling noticeably better from the very next day.

It’s rare to find a doctor who is this approachable, responsive, and genuinely caring. We’re truly grateful for her care and would strongly recommend her to anyone in need of medical care.

I had an excellent experience with Doctor Patong Clinic.
My wife and I became sick during our stay in Phuket, and the clinic arranged for a doctor and nurse to come directly to our hotel, which was incredibly helpful and convenient.

Dr. Mon and the whole team were very kind, professional, and caring. They checked on us regularly, explained everything clearly, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the whole experience.

The service was fast, organized, and very reassuring, especially while being away from home.

Thank you again to Dr. Mon and the wonderful team for your exceptional care and support. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Phuket.

What impressed me even more was the follow-up care — she checked in on us over the next few days to ensure my husband was recovering well. That level of dedication and personal attention is rare and deeply appreciated.

I highly recommend Dr. Mon to anyone in Phuket in need of medical care. The service, responsiveness, and genuine concern for patients are truly unmatched.
